apiContracts: Authenticated read and write; user_id is session-derived; POST uses expected_revision optimistic concurrency.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Runtime feature schema v2 creates reading_positions idempotently; no numbered D1 migration is introduced.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Schema bootstrap advances from marker v1 to v2 and creates the new table without changing existing tables.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Disable the new API handlers only after confirming no clients depend on them; retain the additive table.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Reader UI autosave is not yet connected; this slice exposes the API only.

privacySecurity.authentication: Both methods require an authenticated session.
privacySecurity.authorization: Every read/write is bound to session u.id; no request-supplied owner field is accepted.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: WHERE rp.user_id=? and insert binds u.id.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Per-account 120 writes/hour; numeric bounds and optimistic revision validation.
privacySecurity.optimisticConcurrency: Initial creation requires expected_revision=0; updates require an existing row with the same owner, novel and revision in the INSERT SELECT predicate, then repeat the revision predicate in ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE.

isolation: Cross-account owner binding and stale revision source invariants

flags: No feature flag; endpoint is additive and requires auth.
stagingSteps: Run all required CI workflows on exact head
Connect reader autosave only after browser-level tests

rollback.codeRollback: Revert API handler and schema bootstrap change; retain the additive table until data-retention review.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No destructive rollback; the table can remain unused.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: No prior reading-position route existed in canonical Worker.
collisionReview.duplicateEntities: No reading_positions table existed in canonical runtime schema v1.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Worker is platform-kernel-owned; API and authorization matrices are refreshed to the exact Worker blob.

changeSummary: Adds owner-scoped reader progress GET/POST API with optimistic concurrency and runtime schema v2; does not yet connect browser reader UI.
acceptanceCriteria: All required workflows pass on exact head.
API and authorization matrices match exact Worker blob.
Every request is authenticated and owner-scoped.
Published and rights-eligible chapter gate is enforced.
No production D1 or deployment action is performed.
A nonzero revision cannot create a missing position; only a matching existing revision can update.
